description_for_human: Discover nearby local events through the Flypost Discovery Protocol.
description_for_model: Flypost Ask provides read-only access to discover local events using the Flypost Discovery Protocol V1. Use /v1/events/near for radius-filtered, nearest-first local event discovery with distance_mi when available, and /v1/events/{event_id} for retrieving specific events. All responses follow the Discovery Protocol V1 envelope.
